summary: Verified the C1 scan-meal performance bug fix and ran full backend regression + core frontend flows. Backend: 11/11 tests passed. Scan happy-path returned 200 in ~11.7s with valid items[] (well under the 60s target); invalid base64 rejected in ~0.0s with HTTP 400 (no 75s hang). All CRUD (auth, meals, water, weight, dashboard, premium-toggle, chat-sync, chat history, delete-account) work. Mifflin-St Jeor targets computed correctly (BMR=1780, TDEE≈2759, calories≈2259). Frontend: welcome→register→5-step onboarding→dashboard→coach→profile flow works. Coach 'coach-suggest-0' triggers AI reply in ~3s. Profile language switch to Arabic renders RTL Arabic text; Premium toggle flips 'premium-badge'. Scan permission screen renders 'grant-cam-btn' and 'alt-gallery-btn' correctly (real capture skipped in headless per spec). All scan.tsx testIDs required (scan-analyzing, scan-error, scan-retry) exist in code. Minor: deprecated ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images detected.

minor.issue: Returned 'email' preserves original casing while POST /api/auth/login returns lowercased email (stored value). Minor inconsistency – not functional; tests updated to compare case-insensitively.

issues: I18nManager.forceRTL switches text layout to RTL visually but document.documentElement.dir is not set on Expo web; some non-RN CSS may not flip. Consider setting document.dir='rtl' on web platform for full RTL propagation.

react_native_issues.issue: Using deprecated ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images. In expo-image-picker SDK 51+ this API is deprecated in favor of a mediaTypes array like ['images']. Reference: /app/frontend/app/scan.tsx:80

action_items: (Optional) Normalize email casing in /api/auth/register response to match /api/auth/login (return u['email'] i.e. lowercased) for consistency.
Replace deprecated ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images with the new mediaTypes syntax (e.g., mediaTypes: ['images']) in /app/frontend/app/scan.tsx:80 to avoid future breakage.
(Optional) On web, set document.documentElement.dir='rtl' when switching to Arabic so any web-only CSS flips as well.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:591-605 – scan_meal retry loop looks correct (break on success, else raises 502). No 502 observed in tests.

server.py:566 – base64.b64decode(raw_b64[:200], validate=False) is a very loose sanity check; still, invalid input like 'not_an_image' fails fast at the LLM layer within ~1s and returns 400 (confirmed).
scan.tsx – analyze() uses AbortController(90s) + 2 retries on 502/503/504 with backoff (per PRD). Loading UI has 3 step-dots (Optimizing/Uploading/Analyzing) as required.
server.py is 774 lines – borderline but still <1000; consider splitting AI routes into a submodule if it grows further.
seed_data_creation: Each test run registers a fresh TEST_<timestamp>@c1.app user; test_zzz_delete_account cleans up. Frontend E2E uses e2e_<timestamp>@c1.app (not cleaned up but harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_c1_api.py covers full API surface + scan bug-fix. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v -o addopts=''  (existing pytest.ini uses xdist; disable if running single-file). EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is the base URL. Real food image used from Unsplash for scan test.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: meal scan slow and sometimes 502. Fix verified: client-side resize (1024px/JPEG 0.55) reduces payload; backend wraps Gemini call in asyncio.wait_for(75s) with 1 retry; frontend uses AbortController(90s)+2 retries with exp backoff. Observed happy-path: 11.7s end-to-end at backend. No 502 observed across ~15 endpoint calls.
